note: Spec v1.1 §22: every FAIL / BLOCKED / NOT TESTED / NEEDS PHYSICAL DEVICE and open decision; a critical one blocks the release until its evidence exists.

risks.reason: Emulators cannot show HDR / Dolby Vision, real codecs, gesture feel, SD card / SAF on removable storage, real performance
risks.needs: The owner's phone, on the final release (owner's decision NVP15-CHG-0003)
risks.impact: Player, subtitle and storage behaviour on real hardware unproven

risks.reason: Notification test (#48): Android 9 full pause and resume PASS (required check). Android 14: Pause PASS; Resume NOT TESTED, because Android 14 lets an app start a user-initiated download job from the background only after a real tap, which an automated PendingIntent.send() is not
risks.needs: Owner's phone: start a download, leave the app, Pause then Resume from the notification
risks.impact: The app side of pause/resume from the notification is tested on both emulators; the physical tap is not
risks.alternatives: Fix the test until the real scenario passes
risks.closes_when: Owner confirms Pause and Resume from the notification on his phone

risks.reason: Upgrade 14→15 / 13→15 / 12→15 with the real key and Android 8 refusal run only in the release workflow, after the owner's signing approval
risks.impact: Data-keeping upgrade unproven until the release run
risks.closes_when: Release run's upgrade job passes before publishing

risks.reason: B15-SEC-04 fixed in #44 (merged); real playback of credentialed streams not yet seen on a device
risks.impact: Tokens readable on a hostile network until merged
risks.alternatives: Keep; verify with tokens (chosen); verify always
risks.closes_when: Owner confirms his sources still play

risks.reason: B15-PLY-02: Nuvio's ExoPlayer add-on subtitle test failed once in 20 runs on Android 9
risks.impact: Possibly a slow load of add-on subtitles on old devices
risks.closes_when: Root cause found or no recurrence over further runs

risks.reason: Last 62 emulator runs: MpvSurfaceTest failed 3 times at three different steps (activity never reached CREATED, Android 14; first frame, Android 14, same run as a font picker timeout; frame after stop/resume, Android 9, run with more emulator colour-buffer errors). Font picker failed once waiting for the system picker. No app fault proven; #51 records colour and logcat on the next failure
risks.needs: Repeated Android 14 runs; owner's device for the font picker
risks.impact: No defect shown in the app; intermittent emulator timeouts
risks.alternatives: Investigate if repeated (D-12 rule applies to Android 9 only)
risks.closes_when: A failure with #51 diagnostics shows the cause, or no recurrence over further runs
